principle_violations.reason: The method 'pay' in the Order class has multiple responsibilities: processing payments and verifying security codes. This violates the Single Responsibility Principle by coupling payment processing logic with the Order class.
principle_violations.suggestion: Extract the payment processing logic into a separate class dedicated to handling payments. The Order class should use this new class to process payments.

overall_feedback: 1 principle violation found. Please see the details below.
